description: This source file defines the 'Css' class which provides JavaScript interop methods for manipulating CSS related functionality in a Blazor application.

classes.name: Css
classes.description: A class that encapsulates JavaScript interop methods to manipulate CSS properties, such as showing or hiding body overflow.

methods.name: ShowBodyOverflow
methods.description: Asynchronously invokes a JavaScript function to show the body's overflow property.

methods.name: HideBodyOverflow
methods.description: Asynchronously invokes a JavaScript function to hide the body's overflow property and returns the result.
